Build clean, exit 0.

Two real bugs, rest is noise (deprecation spam from bump):

- `src/core/options.js` — read `options.retries`, new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — threw on `undefined` flag instead of treating unset as disabled. Fixed: only `true` enables backoff, everything else (`undefined`, `false`) returns `false`.

Build now finishes with 8 warnings (deprecation noise, harmless), 0 errors.
